member.summary: The single point of entry to the plugin Accepts an IPluginContext object which holds the current context of the running Web Service. It then transforms the XML text from the Web Service corresponding to the XML format expected by J.D. Edwards, writes the transformed XML to a SQL Server database and passes it on to J.D. Edwards. It also takes the response XML returned from J.D. Edwards and writes it to the SQL Server database
